## Why visit

Worth the extra journey south of the centre for an unspoilt arrangement of rooms around a lobby bar. Stained glass, the snug and the old smoke-room seating give it a different texture from a modern open-plan ale bar. The beer interest is local rather than encyclopaedic: a chance to assess Robinsons in a pub praised by the local CAMRA branch for how it serves that brewery’s ales. It is a sensible addition for traditional-pub enthusiasts who have time beyond the central circuit, especially if a winter Old Tom opportunity can be confirmed.

## Beer

Robinsons cask range; CAMRA lists Old Tom, Unicorn and changing/alternating brewery beers. Treat listed beers as leads to check.
